confirm.title: Email confirmed
confirm.body: You're all set. The daily email arrives when new dailies drop, if it's turned on in Settings.
confirm.error: That confirmation link has expired or was replaced by a newer one. Ask for a new one in Settings.

unsubscribe.title: You're unsubscribed
unsubscribe.body: No more daily emails. You can turn them back on in Settings any time.
unsubscribe.error: That unsubscribe link isn't valid. You can turn the emails off in Settings instead.

tooMany: Too many tries: wait a minute and open the link again.
unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Open the link again in a moment.
